decision: Selected the location point that the national Construction Information System (BIS) publishes for the planned structure of construction case BIS-BL-975692-8018, Datu centrs "Veronikas" (structure cadastral designation 98660140022001, main land unit 98660140022, Tārgale parish, Ventspils municipality), as the project locator. The point lies inside the VZD cadastral polygon of the main land unit, 8 m from its centroid, so it locates the development land unit rather than the planned building footprint, an entrance or a works extent.
source_coordinate_note: The CSV gives decimal-degree longitude and latitude with no stated datum; they are treated as geographic coordinates on the ETRS89-based Latvian frame, which agrees with WGS84 to well under a metre at this scale.
